## nf-core-demo: nf-core/demo 555d145, -profile test

notes: The FastQC reports differ only in the date of the run (the native runs were a day earlier); pipeline_dag is the graph page of iunctus, not the Mermaid page of Nextflow. Recorded without network: iunctus took the test data from its downloads, with NXF_OFFLINE=true.
